# Switch supported time ranges and refresh portfolio performance context

> Prove that selecting any supported time-range value keeps exactly one active choice and refreshes the chart range, x-axis labels, and period comparison.

## Step 1

Open {{portfolio_overview_url}} in a browser and wait for the Portfolio Overview workspace to finish loading with the Portfolio Performance card visible.

## Step 2

Assert the workspace header's time-range segmented control shows 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, YTD, 1Y, and ALL, with 1M as the only active value on first load.

## Step 3

capture baseline: current performance chart data range, visible x-axis labels, and displayed period comparison for the currently active time range.

## Step 4

For each time-range option 1D, 1W, 1M, 3M, YTD, 1Y, and ALL, select that option in the segmented control and confirm it becomes the only active value while the performance chart data range, visible x-axis labels, and displayed period comparison change from the captured baseline.

## Step 5 — assert @verifies ac-11, ac-12, ac-13, ac-15, ac-17

Confirm state-transition check: performance chart data range (changed-by) — the stated promise: Selecting a different time-range value updates the performance chart data range.
